units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Sabb. II, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ שרפה</he> oil of T’rumah which is condemned to be burnt on account of contamination; <he>ש׳ קיק</he>, v. <cite ref="S01137"><he>קִיק</he></cite>. Ib. 2 <he>ש׳ דגים</he> fish-oil; <he>ש׳ אגוזים</he> nut-oil &c. Ib. 17ᵇ <he>שׁמְנָן</he> their oil, manufactured by gentiles; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36a:11">Ab. Zar. 36ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ רב יהודה וכ׳</he> as to gentiles’ oil, R. Judah and his court voted on it and permitted it.
Pes. 83ᵇ; Ḥull. 91ᵃ; 92ᵇ שַׁמְנוֹ the fat surrounding the nervus ischiadicus, v. שׁוּמָן; a. fr.—עֵץ ש׳ pine-wood, v. עֵץ.—Pl. שְׁמָנִים, שְׁמָנִין.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:2">Sabb. II, 2</cite> <he>מתירין בכל הש׳</he> allow all kinds of oil to be used for Sabbath lights. Ib. 26ᵃ <he>כל הש׳ יפין וכ׳</he> all oils are good for ink, but olive oil is the best.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:8:1">Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵇ</cite> top; a. fr.
